claims.text: Explora Atacama sits on a 42-acre (17-hectare) desert estate near San Pedro de Atacama.

findings.quote: Situated on a pristine 42-acre (17-hectare) desert estate near San Pedro de Atacama

claims.text: The lodge sits on the Ayllu de Larache, surrounded by the sand dunes and high-elevation parklands of San Pedro de Atacama.

findings.quote: Explora Atacama boasts a perchon the beautiful Ayllu de Larache, surrounded by the sand dunes and high-elevation parklands of enchanting San Pedro de Atacama

claims.text: The lodge was designed by Chilean architect Jose Cruz Ovalle.

findings.quote: Designed by famed Chilean architect José Cruz Ovalle

claims.text: Soaring spaces, sweeping views and locally sourced furnishings define the grounds and interiors.

findings.quote: Soaring spaces, sweeping views and locally sourced furnishings define the grounds and interiors

claims.text: One of the pools is warmed to 77 to 82 degrees Fahrenheit (25 to 28 degrees Celsius).

claims.text: Explora's private Puritama Conservation Reserve lies deep in an Andean canyon and is a river oasis and sanctuary for endangered wildlife.

findings.quote: Encompassing a unique ecoregion deep in an Andean canyon of the Atacama Desert, Explora’s private Puritama Conservation Reserve offers an important river oasis and sanctuary for endangered wildlife.

claims.text: Guides are trained at Explora's own School of Guides and are fluent in Spanish and English.

findings.quote: They’re trained at our own School of Guides and fluent in Spanish and English.

claims.text: Each evening an Explora guide meets with guests to tailor the next day's Explorations to their preferences.

findings.quote: every evening, when your Explora guide meets with you to tailor the next day’s Explorations to your preferences.

claims.text: Explorations include hiking the Cordillera de la Sal with views to the Valley of the Moon.

findings.quote: These Atacama adventures and experiences include hiking the Cordillera de la Sal with views to the Valley of the Moon

claims.text: The stay includes breakfast, lunch and dinner, all beverages, wine and an open bar.

findings.quote: Your stay at Explora Atacama includes every dining experience during your stay, including breakfast, lunch and dinner, as well as all beverages, wine and an open bar.
